notes.reason: QPC wall intervals combine executing, waiting and off-CPU time; fixed S/M,M/S,S/M order has only one reverse pair and no randomized independent replication. Spread, pair contrasts and warmup comparisons do not identify a mechanism or prove host noise.
notes.missing_measurement_source_point: Frozen sync-user-bench.c worker_interval lines 366 and 376 bracket each hot loop with QPC only. Missing: same-interval per-worker native-thread CPU runtime and running/blocked/runnable timeline tied to runID/worker/native thread identity, with the timing provider verified as per-thread. GetThreadTimes is absent from these receipts; research85 warns that Wine macOS ThreadTimes may fall back to process CPU. Do not substitute that unverified value.
notes.finish_barrier_boundary: Lines 379-380 spin at a finish barrier after each worker stops QPC. tail_after_own_end_ns is a wall-time opportunity for post-loop activity while slower peers remain measured, NOT measured barrier residency, CPU, interference, or cause. Actual arrival/exit and native execution state are missing.
notes.metric: ns per completed worker iteration from min(begin) to max(end); no subtraction. Worker interval sums/intersections are wall interval geometry, not CPU, utilization, isolated API latency, kernel-park proof or wake percentiles.
notes.spread: range_pct_of_median = 100*(max-min)/median, descriptive only; three whole-run samples per backend, four nested batches per run are not independent replicates.
notes.order: All paired percentages use 100*(M/S-1), regardless of execution order. reverse_minus_mean_forward_pp is pair1 minus mean(pair0,pair2), in percentage points; same-order drift is pair2 minus pair0. These are descriptive, not corrected verdicts or estimates of an order effect.
notes.warmup: measurement_vs_warmup_pct compares normalized envelope/iteration costs, not raw durations. Warmup always precedes measurement, uses fewer iterations, reuses workers and resets state. It cannot prove convergence or isolate warming from phase length/contention changes.
notes.preservation: All 90 receipts' rows are copied with all original field values into receipt_rows, including checks, warmup, measurement, begin, summary and complete; all original cells and run summaries retained. Original file bytes remain unchanged. No run retried, excluded, rewritten or reweighted. No gate change or new benchmark.
